scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,extension -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @multimeet/server" "npm run dev -w @multimeet/web" "npm run dev -w @multimeet/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @multimeet/shared && npm run build -w @multimeet/server && npm run build -w @multimeet/web && npm run build -w @multimeet/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @multimeet/shared && npm run test -w @multimeet/server && npm run test -w @multimeet/web
